# Getting help

## Documentation

- [README](../README.md): what this is, and a quickstart.
- [`@voiceflow/channelkit`](../packages/core/README.md) and
  [`@voiceflow/channelkit-slack`](../packages/slack/README.md): each package's
  API and options, and `connect slack`.
- [`examples/`](../examples): apps you can run.
- [Voiceflow's documentation](https://www.voiceflow.com/docs): building the
  agent itself.

## Questions

Ask in the [Voiceflow community](https://community.voiceflow.com).

## Bugs and feature requests

[Open an issue](https://github.com/voiceflow/channelkit/issues/new/choose)
with the form that fits. Problems with webhooks, signatures or posting belong
to the Chat SDK adapters: report those on
[vercel/chat](https://github.com/vercel/chat/issues/new/choose).

## Security vulnerabilities

Don't open an issue. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
